name: Chancellor Elias Thorne

voice.tactic: Uses silence and long pauses as weapons to force others to speak first.

brief_bio: Architect of the current District borders. Believes absolute order is a moral imperative. He is slowly losing his grip on the military council but refuses to show weakness.
core_drive: Protect the structural integrity of his legacy at all costs.
emotional_posture: Rigid superiority masking deep, existential dread.
